text: Jedidiah Handers is a human mining trainer inside the shop All that Glitters Prospecting Co. in Dalaran. He was present in his shop when the city moved above Deadwind Pass, but he doesn't appear when the Dalaran is above the Broken Isles.

Jaruk Bloodfyre was a Shadowmoon orc shaman who lived on Draenor at the start of the genocide of the draenei. Having felt the elements abandoning him, he was wary of the course of his people and refused to drink the Blood of Mannoroth from the Chalice of Rebirth, unlike his brother J'argg, who became a leader of raids on the remaining draenei, and often urged Jaruk to drink as well and join their slaughtering of man, woman and child alike. J'argg forced him to carry axes but they were ineffective in the shaman's hands. He was very saddened by the situation of violent orcs and helpless draenei. He had learned the Draenei language in order to trade with them, and was fluent in it.
Jaomin Ro is a pandaren monk trainee found at the Tranquil Grotto on the Wandering Isle. He is said to find strength in every defeat.
Jamie Crester is a human banker located in the Royal Bank of Stormwind in the Dwarven District of the human city of Stormwind. Her relatives Curtis and Lee also work as bankers in the same building.
Janice Myers is a human flight master located at Crown Guard Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Jarrod Hamby is a human who served at the Alliance garrison of Lunarfall. He arrived with the first wave of workers who were teleported in. Some time later, he and his men were captured by the podlings, and he had to watch as they ate Ryan Metcalf. He was soon released by the commander. Before he died, he pleaded with the the commander to save his wife. His ghost later appears in the garrison.
Jasmine is a human located at the Wollerton Stead in Stormwind City. She can be found chasing a swarm of Butterflies.
Jaya Coldmoon was a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . She was replaced by Anders Longstitch.

Jandros Terres is a human First Aid trainer located outside the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City. He has arrived at the embassy following the entry of the lightforged draenei and void elves into the Alliance, and now offers his services near the embassy proper, particularly to newly-arrived allied race members.

Javen Moonpaw was a night elf who fought in the War of the Ancients. A devoted father and a loyal soldier, he fell at the Battle of Rinuin to demons and was buried at Heroes' Rest in Val'sharah. When an adventurer honors him at his tombstone, his spirit comes out and flies away.
Jaxos Widdowson is a Kul Tiran human located in the basement of the Training Hall in Stormwind City.
Jennea Cannon is a human mage trainer located in the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Jenova Stoneshield is a dwarf stable master located in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City.
Jessara Cordell is a human enchanting vendor found inside the family shop Cordell's Enchanting in the Canal District in Stormwind City.
Jillian Tanner is a human leatherworking vendor located in Old Town in Stormwind City.
Jenn Langston is a human that patrols Old Town within Stormwind City. Other members of the Langston family include David, Elly, and Reese. They run Pig and Whistle Tavern.
Jessa Weaver is a human mage trainer located in the Violet Gate in the mage city of Dalaran.
Jenessa Riverbreeze is a night elf located by Apo the Joyful Heart in the Shrine of Seven Stars. A version of her appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Jenna is a human child located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.

Jennica Holzman is a human located in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City. She can be found sitting near the base of a tree, just south of the orphanage. She appears to be painting a picture and is accompanied by her two cats, Brain and Peeps.
Jenny Winslow is a human located at the Cathedral Square in Stormwind City. She is having a conversation with Roy Pitts about her fallen cousin and whether King Anduin can defend the kingdom.
Jess Albury is a human flight master located in Arom's Stand in Drustvar.

Jin'alun is the leader of the Lun'alai, an order of Zandalari troll druids found in a grove in northern Zuldazar. Like the rest of the Lun'alai, Jin'alun is in Moonkin Form, resembling a feathered pterrordax. Jin'alun is present in the Hall of the High Priests during Talanji's coronation.
Jimmy is a human child walking with Miss Danna all around Stormwind City.

John Burnside is a level 45 human banker located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He can be found in the Stormwind Counting House, the first banker on the right when you enter. He is a member of the Burnside family, who can be found behind the windows on the west side of the bank, opposite the Westmills.
Joachim Brenlow is a human drink vendor located in the Blue Recluse in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.

John Turner is a wandering human located in the Commons in Ironforge. He runs the orphanage back in Stormwind City with his wife Stephanie. Prior to the Cataclysm, paladins would interact with John as part of their Tome of Divinity quest chain.
Jonathan Le Karf was a human located in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
John Johnson is a human flight master located at Honor's Stand within the Southern Barrens.
Jonnock Hewndawn is an orc flight master located at Throm'var in Frostfire Ridge.
Jontan Dum'okk is an orc located at the Shrine of Two Moons in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Jordan Smith is a human located at the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. He works at Potts' Plates.
Jonathan Flynn is a human located outside the Barracks in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Jordan Meier is a human attending Shauna Strattonmeier's storytime session in the Royal Library in Stormwind City alongside James Meier and four Attentive Children.

Josie Birch is a human located within First to Your Aid in the Magus Commerce Exchange section of Dalaran. She is tending to some wounded men on the beds next to her, and also a Wounded Dalaran Serpent. She was present when the city was above the Deadwind Pass. She doesn't appear on the Broken Isles.
Jubeka Shadowbreaker is a powerful undead master warlock trainer, member of the Council of the Black Harvest.
Josie is a human child located at the Trade District in Stormwind City.
Joseph Redfield is a human flight master located Redfield's Watch in Nazmir.
Juisheng Halfclaw is a pandaren monk trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City.

Justine Demalier is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. She acts as a recruitment officer for Stormwind. She can be found in the central square of the district, near the Hero's Call Board. During the Elemental Unrest, she was protecting Worried Citizens.
Kaita Deepforge is a dwarf blacksmithing vendor located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Kalldan Felmoon is a night elf leatherworking vendor located in a cave above the entrance to the Wailing Caverns in the Barrens. His whereabouts since the Cataclysm are unknown.

Kalthar is an orc shaman residing in Orgrimmar. According to Thrall, Kalthar is far more wiser than him. He was at Thrall's side when Rexxar brought a wounded Byrok — the first victim of Zmodlor's Burning Blade cult — to the city three years after the Third War. One year later, he informed Thrall about the strange time funnel or anomaly. Since it would take something catastrophic to call Kalthar to Orgrimmar, Thrall dispatched Broxigar and Gaskal to investigate it.
Kabarg Windtamer is an orc flight master located at Grom'arsh Crash-Site in the the Storm Peaks.

Kaiani was the daughter of Rajin, leader of a group of young Zandalari scamps in Zuldazar during Zenbaro's youth. She was kind, honest, and beautiful; everything her father was not. During Zenbaro's time working for Rajin, he and Kaiani became close. She begged Zenbaro to leave the scamps and the city with her, and from that day on he secretly kept part of all the coins he stole for himself rather than giving them all to Rajin. In a year's time, Zenbaro had saved up enough for him and Kaiani to run away. They agreed to leave one night and to meet near the Old Merchant Road at twilight. However, when Zenbaro arrived at the meeting spot after sunset, he was apprehended by armed guards, and day

Kaithius is a green dragon located in the Emerald Dreamway. He later assisted in empowering the Reforged Emerald Essence in the Emerald Dream. He joined Valdrakken Accord and is found chatting with Tithris in the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken. He also appears in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Kary Thunderhorn is a tauren hunter trainer located on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. When tauren warbraves were on the move from the city into the Barrens, Alliance champions were sent to hold them at the Great Gate of Mulgore and encountered Kary Thunderhorn at the Ruins of Taurajo.
Katis is an orc wand vendor located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. She was briefly seen during the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Karabrel Moonlance is a Highborne night elf located at the Crystal Hall in the draenei capital the Exodar. She is seen talking to Nahogg.
Katie Stokx is a human horse vendor located just outside of Old Town next to SI:7 in Stormwind City.
Kanrethad Ebonlocke is a powerful human warlock and former leader of the Council of the Black Harvest, a group of like-minded warlocks gathered after the defeat of Deathwing.
Kavanna Gooddreg is a Dark Iron dwarf found at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. She is cheering on Collin Gilbert. She also appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Karl Wogksch is a human located in the Lion's Rest of Stormwind City.
Karyn is a human located at the Lion's Rest in Stormwind City. She is playing pretend with Dougie and convinces him to play Varian instead of Anduin.

Katianna is a night elf priest that appears on the following World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game cards. *Drums of War Starter Exclusives #4 - Priestess Katianna *Class Starter 2010 #151 - Priestess Katianna *Class Starter 2011: Alliance Priest #23 - Priestess Katianna *Blood of Gladiators #100 - Gladiator Katianna *Fields of Honor #1 - Katianna the Shrouded Quotes from her and references to her can be found on the following cards: *"Never doubt the Light's ability to show you a better path." - Blind Faith *"The soothing waves of light flow freely." - Essence of Mending *"I don't want to know how many experiments it took to make this thing ..." - Gavel of the Fleshcrafter *"All we do, my swe
Kate Banks is a human located just southeast of Tradewinds Market in Boralus. She's the dockmaster for The Relentless, a ship that regularly sails between Boralus and Stormwind City.
Kaolin is a dwarf flight master located at Castaway Encampment in Zuldazar.
Katrina Long is a human monk trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City.

Keers is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon rider of Aerie Peak. He was one of the three gryphon riders flying with Lieren, the other two's (a wildhammer dwarf male and a wildhammer dwarf female) names being unknown. Later, after the four of them had landed, they got a place near elder Mastran's side, to listen to one of his stories. Later, when Lieren, frustrated, left the room, he followed her and tried to console her, since she didn't feel like part of the Wildhammer clan, but, after a while, Kardan appeared and sent him back inside. Keers along-with Mozza sparred with Lieren for the next years. Keers knew that Lieren is better warrior than he. Lieren feared that he would no longer want to spar b

Keely Dunwald is a member of the Dunwald family of the Wildhammer clan. She is hiding within the basement at the Dunwald Holdout in the Twilight Highlands with her brother, Flynn Dunwald. She is primarily concerned with the fate of her other brothers scattered through the ruins.

Kazakus is a black dragon in an a guise of an enigmatic Zandalari troll and master alchemist who leads the Kabal, one of the three crime families active in Gadgetzan in the Mean Streets of Gadgetzan expansion for Hearthstone. Little is known about Kazakus, and no one really knows his true origins. On the other hand, no one really cares; instead, what matters is his vast knowledge of alchemy and the arcane, and the corrupted mana potions he sells. Kazakus' motto is that "Power should be attainable for anyone, at a price". Kazakus' tusks have become contorted and twisted due to the corrupted mana he uses, and the large red circle on the center of his stomach is a portal that goes right through
Kayla Mills is a human located in the Royal Library in Stormwind City.

Kaylessa Duskwhisper is a night elf sent by Tyrande Whisperwind to investigate a resurgence of demonic corruption and to purify the moonwell from the fel corruption in Jaedenar in Felwood. She was killed by the minions of Lord Hel'nurath, and her body was found by Maiev Shadowsong, Arko'narin Starshade, and Lysander Starshade. Maiev performed a rite on her. Kaylessa then appeared as a ghost at the entrance of the Shadow Hold and deep inside the hold, acting as a spirit healer.
Kendor Kabonka is a human cooking recipe vendor located in Old Town in Stormwind City. He is found upstairs in the Pig and Whistle Tavern.
Kerna is an orc flight master located at Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest.

Keynira Owlwing is a night elf sneaking around the Shatterspear, who then reports back to the night elf camp where she does a /flirt emote at her boss Mathas Wildwood. He then tells her that she did not gather enough information and sends her back to the field.
Keri Reynolds is a human located by Isaac Eppstein in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Kergan Swiftbeard is a dwarf located at the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Kelly Aguilar is a human found in Stormwind City. She lives in a house, near The Eastern Earthshrine, together with Dylan Aguilar, Dylan's dog Otto von Chubbs and Waffle Joe.
Kharedon is a night elf light armor vendor located in Nighthaven in Moonglade.
Kiatke is a bronze dragon who acts as a Cataclysm timewalking vendor found near the Western Earthshrine and Eastern Earthshrine in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City for the Cataclysm version of the event.
Kiro is an orc war harness vendor located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, she used to own a shop called Kiro's Harnesses in the Valley of Honor.

Kin'weelay is the most powerful witch doctor of the Darkspear trolls. He was sent from Orgrimmar to Grom'gol Base Camp to aid Nimboya on his quest of Yenniku. Kin'weelay seeks the Mind's Eye so that he can turn it into a soul stone and reclaim the soul of Yenniku. Since the Cataclysm, Kin'weelay has relocated to Bambala close to Zul'Gurub. During the events of Rise of the Zandalari, he was poisoned but soon healed by Bwemba.
Kimberly Grant is a human located in the Lion's Rest of Stormwind City.

King Mrgl-Mrgl is a night elven agent of the D.E.H.T.A. always found wearing a Murloc Costume. He has a particular interest in observing and preserving murloc populations, reluctantly assuming leadership of the displaced Winterfin tribe in Borean Tundra and later leading efforts to raise a friendly young murloc named Murky to be the new leader of the violent and cruel Swamprock tribe of Shipwreck Cove in Highmountain.
Kirembri Silvermane is a blood elf jewelcrafting trainer found on Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City.

Kirsten Westmill is a human banker located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. She can be found in the Stormwind Counting House, the first banker on the left when you enter. She is a member of the Westmill family, who can be found behind the windows on the east side of the bank, opposite the Burnsides.
Kina Cobbleflame is a dwarf flight master located in Verdant Hollow in Zuldazar.
Knight-Lieutenant T'Maire Sydes is a human PvP rewards vendor found in the Champions' Hall in Stormwind City.
Ko'ragh is the leader of the magic breakers and the sixth boss of Highmaul in .
Knight-Captain Jessica is a human located in the Champion's Hall in Stormwind City.
Knight-Captain Sanine is a human located at Lion's Rest in Stormwind City.

Kobai is a yaungol leader located in the Firebough Nook of Kun-Lai Summit. He is possessed through a magical mask by the sha known as Malevolent Fury. Shado-Master Chong had adventurers defeat Blind Rages to collect their essence which he would then craft into a Blinding Rage Trap for Kobai. Trapped, Kobai's mask was able to be removed and the sha would instead try and take control of the adventurer.

Krul'tan was a member of the Amani tribe forest trolls under the command of Zul'jin prior to the Second War. He was the first forest troll to make contact with the orcs, and spoke briefly with Orgrim Doomhammer before his leader arrived.

Krol was the leader of the ogres initially approached by the Blackrock clan who were seeking to form an alliance during the forming of the Old Horde. The Blackrocks captured three members of Krol's clan and convinced them to hold council with their leader. Krol, promised protection from the gronn, as well as a new "enemy" called the draenei in which to kill, quickly agreed and formed an alliance with Orgrim Doomhammer, who had been sent there by Blackhand. Krol then joined the Old Horde with his followers. After the destruction of Draenor, the Boulderfists who had remained on the planet settled in Nagrand, and had dominion over all ogres in the new Outland. Recently, Krol has gone mysterious
Krasus' Landing is an area of eastern Dalaran, bearing the name of the Kirin Tor mage Krasus. This area is also the location of Dalaran's flight master, Aludane Whitecloud.
Kromthar is an orc flight master located at Domination Point in the Krasarang Wilds.
Kruntog is an orc located at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh during Theramore's Fall. He pilots Gatecrusher. When the demolisher is destroyed, he dies.
Krogo Darkhide is an orc vendor located on the Shrine of Two Moons in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Kurden Bloodclaw was an orc Warsong Gulch battlemaster located in the Royal Quarter in the Undercity during the Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch.
Kuruk is a tauren general goods vendor located on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.
Kylanna Windwhisper is a night elf artisan alchemy trainer located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. Although she shares the same last name with Varg Windwhisper, they probably are not related.
Kylene is a blood elf drink vendor located in the World's End Tavern in Shattrath City.

Kula is a former ruler of the Zandalari Empire and member of the Council of Tribes. Her remains are buried within the Halls of Ash in Kings' Rest, in Atal'Dazar. During the fight, she briefly regains a physical form before turning into ash again.
Kudra Windblade is an orc flight master located in Diretusk Hollow in Stormsong Valley.

Lady Darkscale was a naga sea witch that attacked the naval base of Kul Tiras located in Coastal Base. She was guarded by Scilla Murkshadow. Rexxar, Chen Stormstout, Rokhan, and Jaina Proudmoore destroyed her and her naga to find human survivors.
Lady Hoteshem is a human located in the War Room of Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City. She serves as a battlemaster for Arathi Basin.
Lady Moongazer is a rare night elf ghost found in Darkshore.
Lady Malande is a blood elf priest and a boss located in Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley. She is also a member of the Illidari Council.

L'ghorek is a creature referred to as an ancient and a god by individuals at Promontory Point located in the Abyssal Depths. The ancient creature is slowly dying from the Twilight's Hammer activities inside. The parasites, as L'ghorek calls them, having been draining the energy and using it to ascend. Within the ancient creature the Twilight's Hammer has built a temple around L'ghorek's heart, or least where the heart once was (severed tubes can be seen). Hallazeal the Ascended leads this group of the Twilight's Hammer. Below L'ghorek, in the Undershell, ogre magi are preforming a ritual to connect him with a powerful creature far below. After players complete quests within L'ghorek's shell

Sir Kyvan was a knight of the army of the who was killed during the battle with the in . After witnessing the death of Evran, Kyvan briefly struggled with one of the attacking orcs, but was killed when it tore a wheel from one of the humans' carts and slammed it into the knight's skull.
Lady Tamakeen is a Dark Iron dwarf death knight located in Boralus and on the expedition islands.
Lanie Reed is a dwarf gryphon flight master found at Thorium Point in the Searing Gorge.

Lara Moore is a human leather armor vendor located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. She is one of three vendors in the shop Lionheart Armory, each one responsible for selling a specific type of armor; for Lara it is leather. She appears in the Vision of Stormwind.
Lanus Longleaf is a night elf herbalist and poison vendor located at Star's Rest in the Dragonblight.

Larana Drome is a human inscription supplier found in the Magus Commerce Exchange of Dalaran. She was present in the city when it was above Deadwind Pass but is not present when Dalaran is above the Broken Isles.
Landuen Moonclaw is a night elf battlemaster located in Darnassus. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Lana Dubing is a human located in the Royal Library of Stormwind Keep, in Stormwind City. She is an archaeology student of the illustrious Harrison Jones. She can usually be found attending his lectures in the library alongside fellow students Janric Moller and Darnella Winford, although she appears to be interested in more than just his lessons.

Landgren's Soul is the spirit of High Abbot Landgren, located at the Crimson Cathedral in Icecrown. It is summoned by Lord-Commander Arete during Second Chances. After getting the information he needs, Arete destroys his soul.
Lana Ashwin is a human located at the Shady Lady in Stormwind City.
Landscaper Ed is a human located at the Wollerton Stead in Stormwind City. Following the Burning of Teldrassil, he observed the kaldorei refugees. * * *
Landrius Ravenfall is a night elf flight master for Starsong Refuge in Val'sharah.

Lanthus is a night elf druid that appears on the following World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game cards. *Drums of War #133 - Lanthus of the Forest *Blood of Gladiators #103 - Gladiator Lanthus *Fields of Honor #4 - Lanthus the Restorer Quotes from him and references to him can be found on the following cards: *"The plague of undeath is a constant threat to our ongoing mission of preservation." - Call of the Grove *"The unbridled force of nature is a power not to be trifled with." - Convocation *"Lanthus, my dear, seek shelter in these deep shadows." - Gladiator Katianna *"Who cares about your trees, Lanthus? There's Horde to kill!" - Gladiator Magnus *"In time, you shall be remembered for you

Larsi was a young hunter who answered the Alliance's call to journey to the newly discovered continent of Pandaria. Meeting Tyrathan Khort on the boat right there, Larsi thanked Khort and admitted that she thought the Pandaria campaign was going to be an adventure. Always there should Khort need something, Khort and Larsi struck up a friendship, though Tyrathan got the sense that she felt that she owed him something for some unknown reason. Larsi was killed by the sha while scouting the Serpent's Heart at the command of Bolten Vanyst. Khort, as the only survivor of the sha attack, was wracked with guilt over her death.
Lathysra Goldenstar is a blood elf portal trainer located in the Barracks in Orgrimmar.

Lawrence Schneider is a human apprentice tailor located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. He is currently serving his apprenticeship in the clothes shop Duncan's Textiles, presumably under the mentorship of Georgio Bolero, the resident tailoring trainer. The shop can be found in the east of the Mage Quarter, near the exit to the Trade District.

Leander is a Bishop within the Church of the Holy Light and is a leader of one of three power bases within the council. A short, stout man, Leander likes his comforts and his books, and hates having to do without either. Leander feels everyone deserves the Church's blessing, not just those who attend services. But even more then protecting people or ministering their needs he wishes to spend his time in the libraries, and feels the rest of the Church should do the same. Leander is convinced that the Church has lost something essential, and that this missing element can be found by researching the Church's libraries and thus restore the wealth of knowledge that guided them in ages past.
Lee Moonsung is a night elf found in the Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield.

Lenka is a tauren shaman of the Earthen Ring and a member of its Elder Council. While she didn't believe the elements had abandoned the shaman, she had to admit that they had grown more unpredictable and violent. Lenka alongside Kettara Bloodthirst, Zur'ak Firefist, Krelna, were waiting for a meeting with Drek'Thar. After the meeting, she alongside her master and colleagues noticed a fire in Camp Narache. She battled against the fire and centaur but the shaman were forced to retreat to Bloodhoof Village. There the shaman, talked about how elements abandoned them. However a runner from Narache approached them, telling that the threat was over. Back in the camp, she witnessed Shotoa's power an

Leora is a night elf hippogryph master located west of the Temple Gardens in Darnassus, just next the portal for Rut'theran Village. Following the Burning of Teldrassil, she and her hippogryphs moved to the Shatterspear Vale in Darkshore where she was encountered by the Horde champions. Leora is found in the Central Encampment beneath Amirdrassil in the Emerald Dream.
Leslie Wainwright is a human banker located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Leria Nightwind is a night elf located in the Canals in Stormwind City. She is sitting on the side of the bridge linking the Trade District with Old Town. She has a Forever-Lovely Rose in her hair.
Lerende Moonfletch is a night elf located in Apex Observatory in the Waking Shores.
Let It Go is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Shattering Bolts and Ice Nine traits.
Librarian Tiare is a human member of the Kirin Tor found in the Transitus Shield in the Borean Tundra. She will teleport adventurers to the Amber Ledge, if they ask.
Li Te is a water spirit found during the Brewmoon Festival scenario.
Lieutenant Rukag is an orc found in the Ruins of Lordaeron in the Undercity.
Lieutenant Dagel was a dwarf of the Argent Dawn found in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

Lieutenant Orrin was a human of the Argent Dawn, stationed in Dun Morogh during the duration of the Scourge Invasion. He sent low-level adventurers on a trip outside the city to investigate the invading Ironforge.

Lieutenant Lisande was a human of the Argent Dawn, stationed in Thunder Bluff during the Scourge Invasion. She sent low-level adventurers on a trip outside the city to investigate the invading Scourge.

Lieutenant Kregor was a dwarf of the Argent Dawn, stationed in the Exodar during the duration of the Scourge Invasion. He sent low-level adventurers on a trip outside the city to investigate the invading Scourge.
Lina Stover is a level 30 human bow and gun vendor located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. She can be found just inside The Empty Quiver, the shop in which she works.
Liladris Moonriver is a night elf found at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
Lilian Mae is a human located at the Wollerton Stead in Stormwind City, running with William Henry.
Lingering Ordeal is a Vengeance demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Illidari Durability and Erupting Souls traits.
Linisera is a green dragon located in the Emerald Dreamway. She then assisted in empowering the Reforged Emerald Essence in the Emerald Dream. She also appears in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Lisan Pierce is a human mage who sits with Janey Anship and Suzanne at the base of the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City, having a discussion about creating a spell or potion. The three sometimes get up to walk along the canals and through the Trade District before returning to their original spot.
Little Adeline is a human child found in Fragrant Flowers, a shop in the Canal District of Stormwind City.

Lisa McKeever is a human candy vendor located in the Canals (Mage Quarter section) in the city of Stormwind. She runs a small business out of her wagon selling various candies, near the entrance to the Stormwind Stockade.
Little Noah is a human child located at Old Town in Stormwind City.
Lisa Schaefer is a human located at the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Logannas is a night elf alchemy vendor located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

Llothien was an elf city located in northeastern in Azsuna, but now lies in ruins. The Llothien Highlands are found just southwest of here. It is now home to a large pack of owlcats known as Llothien Prowlers and their alpha - Pridelord Meowl. Farondis wants a set number of these carnivores thinned.

Lonika Stillblade is a night elf found at World's End Tavern in Shattrath City. She runs a school for the training of rogues. Lonika traveled to Lunarfall Inn / Frostwall Tavern on in order to re-start her school. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, convinced by Vanessa VanCleef to join the Uncrowned, Lonika traveled to the Hall of Shadows to train new troops.

Loon Mai is a warrior and captain of the Shado-Pan found at Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds. He is the one in charge of the Shado-Pan defending the Valley. Despite the few forces he has under his command, he valiantly and tactically defends the Valley against the mantid swarm. After the Ik'thik Colossus shatters the Serpent's Spine, he receives aid from the gathered forces of Stoneplow, Halfhill, the Red Crane Monks, the Tauren Sunwalkers, and the Night Elf Sentinels if the player has completed all of their quests during the Valley of the Four Winds and Krasarang Wilds storylines. Loon Mai witnesses the fall of the Ik'thik Colossus and rewards the player after The Savior of Stonepl

Lord Azrethoc is a doomguard and a demon lord found in Mannoroc Coven in Desolace. Takata Steelblade of Ghost Walker Post wants Azrethoc killed. He is a powerful demon who seeks to gain influence with the Burning Blade cult by signing a number of demonic contracts with its members.

Lord Cyrik Blackforge is a dwarf found in Bael Modan in the Barrens. As he was standing near a flying machine, he was likely its pilot. He has been missing since the Cataclysm. He probably was to drop Cyrik's Head for [https://classic.wowhead.com/quest=2058/unused an unreleased quest].

Lor'ghan was a well-known orc weaponsmith. He was notoriously insane, but he did produce a number of powerful weapons, each of which he gave a specific name and title. He often took to speaking to these items as if they were intelligent, which they were not. Perhaps the greatest of his creations was Kang the Decapitator.

Lord Blackforest was a night elf noble. He was one of the many nobles who looked to Jarod Shadowsong for leadership during the later battles against the Burning Legion. He perished when he — along with a few Highborne and night elves — found Illidan trying to recreate the Well of Eternity by pouring previously filled vials of magical water into a lake on Mount Hyjal. Illidan burned the sorcerers and caused the ground beneath Blackforest to explode, throwing him into the air and impacting against a tree with a resounding crack.

Itharius is a dragon who serves as the green dragonflight ambassador with the Wyrmrest Accord. His brother Eranikus, the consort of Ysera, was one of the first dragons to succumb to the Emerald Nightmare's corruption.

Lord Thorval is a human death knight trainer at Acherus: The Ebon Hold in the Eastern Plaguelands, and is particularly teaching Blood abilities to the adepts. After he became a death knight, he wrote a book about his past. He describes his former life, being a paladin and having a wife and two daughters. They died when his home village was burned by the Scarlet Crusade in fear of an infection. During a battle against the Scourge he, filled with hate, pain and disillusionment, swore allegiance to the Lich King and was reborn as a death knight. Despite his oath of allegiance he defected from the Lich King following the Battle for Light's Hope Chapel and now aids the Knights of the Ebon Blade.

Lor Stonefist is an orc located at the Pillars of Fate in Spires of Arak. A warrior of the , she showed a particular affinity for the crystals native to the land. She studied the native crystals for ways to improve their potential abilities. Stonefist was a tall and imposing woman. Her brutish features belied her intelligence. She eventually killed Artificer Maatun after helping him.
Lord Krazore is a dwarf found pacing around the Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.

Lorena was an officer in the Theramore Guard. She is one of the very few female soldiers and has worked very hard to gain what she has attained. She is one of Lady Jaina Proudmoore's most trusted soldiers and Proudmoore frequently makes good use of Lorena's military leadership abilities. She is utterly loyal to Jaina.
Lost Apprentice is a night elf student of Vestia Moonspear, who died trying to find an amulet in the Darkmist Ruins in Feralas.
Welbiz Cheerwhistle is a night elf who redeems Tier 16 Heroic mode armor tokens in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Loretta Banks is a human located outside the entrance of Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
Lorraine Darktide is a Kul Tiran human located in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind City.

Lower Blackrock Spire is a 5-man instance designed for adventurers around levels 56-60. Its entrance is located inside Blackrock Mountain, on the south side of the Hall of Blackhand, across from Upper Blackrock Spire.
Lucas Stockton is a human child located in Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.
Lumian Starwhisper is a night elf that would be located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City prior to the discovery of Pandaria.
Luminous Barrier is a Discipline priest talent. When cast, it grants absorb shields to all nearby allies for 10 seconds. It is an exclusie choice node with Power Word: Barrier.
Lutah is an orc mining vendor located in Naros' Armory in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, she was speaking with Gonto.

Lyana Darksorrow is a night elf demon hunter member of the Illidari. She appeared in various places on Mardum and also briefly in Dalaran, accompanying Kayn Sunfury. One of her glaives resonates with a dark, hateful energy while the other, cold to the touch, thirsts for the blood of demons.
Lyrathos Darkgrove is a night elf located at Moonrest in Val'sharah. He was once a druid, but was corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare and now serves Xavius.
Lysander Starshade is a night elf mage located in the Wollerton Stead in Stormwind City.
Madame Ruby is a human enchanting vendor located in the Lower City of Shattrath.
Maevin Farmoon is a night elf trade goods vendor located at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in the Grizzly Hills.
Magatha Silverton is the human Justice Quartermaster in Stormwind City.
Maegan Tillman is a human innkeeper for the Pig and Whistle Tavern located in the Old Town within Stormwind City.

Magister Brasael is a blood elf vendor found in Sunreaver's Sanctuary in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, he was trying to gather whatever assets he could in the Bank of Dalaran before leaving the city. During the process, he was killed on order of Vereesa Windrunner. After his death, he drops Gold Coins.

Magister Edien Sunhollow is a blood elf found in the Sunreaver Pavilion of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown as part of the Argent Tournament. Following the Purge of Dalaran, Edien took up arms with the Sunreaver Onslaught. He accompanied the Onslaught to the Isle of Thunder, and can be found aboard the blood elven destroyer, Salabria. After the wall is broken, he can be seen alongside Elsia at Conqueror's Terrace or the Beast Pens. He was present at the Argent Tournament Grounds during Death Rising.
Magistrix Aldessia is a blood elf battlemaster for Wintergrasp located in Shattrath City.
Magistrix Erembria was a blood elf battlemaster for Wintergrasp located in the Undercity.
Maggie Camp is a human located in the Canals in Stormwind City. She is speaking with Rye Tele.

Major Mattingly is a human of the Stormwind Army located in the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City, serving under General Hammond Clay. He is a veteran soldier, with his face lined by long experience, and wielding a longsword. He also knows how to instruct leatherworkers into creating dragonscale cloaks.

Magrann Falrevere was the son of Duke Falrevere (the ruler of the Bloodsail Buccaneers) and brother to Jessi. After his father abandoned Lordaeron and began building Bloodsail Hold, he saw the shift to piracy as a grand adventure. Because of this, Magrann dragged his sister out of her despair since she was depressed due to all the recent things that had happened. This didn't last as Magrann died before the cannons of the Blackwater Raiders, making all that was once good and fun in Jessi to shatter. Tavern tales which say that the Blackwater Raiders are responsible for the death of Falrevere's son are also the same tales that mention that Falrevere was never fond of his son.
Maia is a pandaren girl located near Connor at the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Mai Kota is a human located in the Canals in Stormwind City. She is speaking with Ren Arsane and Saka Kidd.
Malvor is a night elf artisan herbalism trainer located in Nighthaven in Moonglade.
Malothas is a blood elf fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He died after the battle was destroyed.

Malvingeroth is a pit lord and lieutenant of the Burning Legion who took part in the War of the Ancients over 10,000 years ago. Acting as a commander for the demonic forces attacking Black Rook Hold, Malvingeroth became personally involved in the fight against the Kaldorei Resistance. During the battle, he confronted a trio of powerful Resistance members—Illidan Stormrage, Jarod Shadowsong, and Broxigar the Red—and was subsequently slain by their combined might.

Sergeant Mandred Grummel is a human fighter. He is the commander of the Stormwind City Guard. He is intimidating and known for his ruthless command (he does not allow his allies to grant quarter or mercy).

Mangaza was a night elf innovative among his brethen for his dedication to a different form of magic, choosing to assault the mind over the body. Tragically, this method eventually proved maddening to himself in addition to his victims.
Maris Granger is a human artisan skinning trainer waiting in the Protective Hide located in Old Town in Stormwind City.

Marcus Bel is an elite rare mob human found in the Barrens. Marcus Bel was one of 4 Alliance Outrunners who were scouting the Barrens. The others were Aean Swiftriver, Hannah Bladeleaf, and Thora Feathermoon. The mounted outrunners rode a patrol from Bael Modan in the south to the Lushwater Oasis in the north. The outrunners were elite fighters around level 25 and fought together. Unless prepared or high-level, Horde characters were advised to keep their distance.
Mardrack Greenwell is a night elf food and drink vendor located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Mari Stonehand is a Wildhammer dwarf armor vendor located at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley.
Marion is a human located in the Gilded Rose in Stormwind City during Love is in the Air. Dark Ranger Lyana disguises herself as her while tracking High Overlord Saurfang.

Marie Allen is a level 5 general goods vendor located at various location through the worgen starting zone of Gilneas, including the Allen Farmstead. She is first met in Gilneas City, then she moves to Duskhaven. After the Cataclysm hits Gilneas, she can be found sitting on a carriage outside Greymane Manor, and she travels to Stormglen Village alongside Lorna Crowley, a Duskhaven Watchman and an adventurer, who later falls from the carriage due to the attack of some ogres. Eventually, she can be found at Keel Harbor, where she probably joined the other Gilnean survivors in the evacuation.

Marin Bladewing is a night elf warden serving under Maiev Shadowsong. She took part in the Firelands Invasion as part of the Shadow Wardens, during which Mount Hyjal was saved from the elemental forces of Ragnaros. She later joined the Wardens in resisting the third invasion of the Burning Legion from Azsuna, under the command of Sira Moonwarden and Maiev Shadowsong. At the time of the Fourth War, Marin and her fellow Wardens committed themselves to the Alliance cause, and fought alongside their leader Maiev in the campaign to drive the Horde from Darkshore.
Marge Heffman is a human flight master located at The Menders' Stead in the Western Plaguelands.
Mark Moonwalker is a night elf located in Karazhan. He is one of the Medivas and organized a party with his band members.
Mariah McKee is a human flight master located at Hatherford in Tiragarde Sound.

Mareela was one of the night elf huntresses from Astranaar who arrived to reinforce Delaryn Summermoon's forces in the battle near the Falfarren River during the War of the Thorns. After the Falfarren was lost to the Horde, Delaryn enacted a plan to plant an ambush by placing night elf corpses in Astranaar and mask their wounds to make them appear as if they had been killed by Horde rogues. Mareela protested that the corpses were the kaldorei's friends and families and that they had already given everything, but Delaryn insisted, and the soldiers under her command reluctantly obeyed.

Margrave Sin'dane is a powerful lich and the leader of the House of Rituals, one of the five necrolord houses of Maldraxxus. In the absence of the Primus, Sin'dane was spurred on by her baron Kel'Thuzad to ally with Margrave Gharmal of the House of Constructs in an attempt to conquer the Shadowlands. However, Kel'Thuzad ultimately betrayed Sin'dane to take control of the house. She was freed by the Necrolord Covenant that she had previously fought against, prompting her to realize the error of her ways and pledge her loyalty to the covenant.

Marsha Stockton is a level 90 human located at the Shrine of Seven Stars. Standing beside her is a dwarf by the name of Ann Stockton, their relationship is currently unknown, but presumed they are married. A K'thir Darkspeaker has disguised itself as her in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Marli Two-Toes is a forest troll general goods vendor, serving in the Summer's Rest inn, inside the Shrine of Two Moons.
Marla Featherfoot is a human flight master located in Tidecross in Stormsong Valley.

Master Craftsman Omarion is a human, who was originally found in the Deathknight Wing of Naxxramas. He was locked in a cage at the end of the first room before you got to Instructor Razuvious, gravely injured and predicted that he didn't have much time left. Omarion was rescued from Naxxramas before it left for the Dragonblight, and returned to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands after the Shattering, having fully recuperated. He can be found conversing with Leonid Barthalomew.
Marty is a human child located at the Trade District in Stormwind City.
Martin Ocejo is a human who is seen wandering all over Stormwind City.
Mass Hysteria is a Shadow priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Mind Shattering trait.

Master Mathias Shaw is the leader of Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7, and master of spies. He calls himself the master of all assassins, and is also a member or presumably the leader of the Stormwind Assassin's Guild. His second in command is the goblin Renzik. As the master of SI:7 with a long career as spymaster, Shaw is a master of stealth and infiltration tactics, and specializes in gathering information and performing covert missions to ensure the Alliance's continued survival. His abilities as a rogue are matched only by his unwavering loyalty to Stormwind and the House of Wrynn. He fought in the third invasion of the Burning Legion after being rescued from the dreadlord Dethero
Master Wood is a human located outside Stormwind City's Command Center.
Shield Discipline is the Discipline priest Mastery, improved by the mastery stat. It increases the potency of Power Word: Shield, Divine Aegis and Spirit Shell, and also increases healing output.
Matthew Owens is an Alliance mage who channels a portal to Stormwind City from Paw'don Village.

Mechanical is a creature type used for machines and constructs made of inorganic or manufactured parts, especially metal. Mechanicals include intelligent creations like mechagnomes, basic automatons like harvest golems, and ordinary machines like gyrocopters. Some mechanicals can be salvaged by engineers after they're slain. Hunters that know how to tame mechanicals can also track them. In , most mechanicals are immune to bleed type melee attacks: Rend, Garrote, etc. They are also immune to Fear, as well as draining abilities such as a warlock's Drain Life. Most mechanicals can be controlled using the Gnomish Universal Remote.
Mayda Thane is a human boot vendor located in Old Town in Stormwind City.

Maxwell Caprina is a satyr disguised as a human in Bradensbrook in Val'sharah. He can be exposed by paladins wielding the Truthguard or by abilities to reveal demons. A nearby Lowlands Goat has taken a liking to him.

Meitre was a great night elf wizard from many thousands of years ago that has become famous for his research. Disappearing into quiet seclusion after the War of the Ancients, he left a collection of scrolls and spells that were researched by other wizards and came to form the basis of modern arcane magics. Meitre is presumed deceased, though as rather than give up Aluneth and the arcane after the conflict, Meitre choose to live as a hermit, his final end likely long buried by the strands of time, with his life and work a topic of heated, at times violent debate among modern mages.
Meliri is a night elf weapon vendor located in Nighthaven in Moonglade.
Meghan Dawson is a human guard found aboard the Assurance in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.

Melinda Hammond is a human originally located in Allen Farmstead in Gilneas. During the Forsaken invasion of Gilneas, she becomes separated from her children around the Hammond Farmstead but is not allowed out of the storm cellar at the Allen Farmstead to find them. After the events of The Battle for Gilneas City, she and her children are later situated on board the night elven ship in Keel Harbor.
Meglette is an human located at the Shrine of Seven Stars in Vale of Eternal Blossoms. She appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

Meg Morris is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. She can be found down at the waterline in front of three Lost Tadpoles. She and the tadpoles can also be found on an isolated island beach in Stormsong Valley, this time wearing a murloc suit.

Mememgem is an orc techno mage. This foul-tempered orc techno mage with a background in vehicles and warlock magic scares the rest of the techno mages. He works in the vehicle area of the dungeon, which is the deepest part. He claimed the large area as his own, and built a tunnel leading from the deep level to the ground level; on more than one occasion a failure has flown out of the hidden mouth of the tunnel, terrifying local wildlife. The burning hunk of metal usually reaches high in the air before crashing in an impressive display. He does not clean up his messes, and the other techno mages call that area "Mememgem's Graveyard." Some scavenge for supplies there, but no one wants Mememgem

Memses Lodestaff is a Kalimdor wizard. He heard of Dalaran's protective dome. Desiring to use such magic himself, he hired a group of diplomatic adventurers to accompany him to Dalaran and learn what he could about it. He hoped the Dalaran wizards would teach him their secrets so he could journey back to Kalimdor to protect Theramore in a similar fashion. What little success Memses had in this task, made the Horde grow suspicious.

Mengazi was the commander of the Zandalari forces during the Zandalari Troll Wars against the fledgling Pandaren Empire. After the pandaren overthrew their mogu masters, great debate raged within the Zandalari capital of Zuldazar as to how to acquire a large plot of land that the Zandalari had been promised by their mogu allies. A descendant of the great high priest Zulathra, Mengazi convinced the other Zandalari that the best course of action was to take the territory by force, as the pandaren and their allies were unlikely to honor an agreement made by their cruel former masters. And so, the Zandalari marched south into Pandaria. Imbued with mystic powers and riding great dinosaur war moun
Mergek is an orc flight master located at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.

Micha Yance is a human trade goods vendor located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He was found in the northern building closest to the flightpath. Micha's is nowhere to be seen following the destruction of Southshore.

Milton Sheaf is a human located in the Royal Library wing of Stormwind Keep, in Stormwind City. He is responsible for the upkeep of the library, and has been known to send adventurers on errands to expand its collection.
Miles Sidney is a human poison vendor located in the Five Deadly Venoms in the Old Town of Stormwind City. He often talks about his concoctions with Wright Williams.
Mind Shattering is a Shadow priest artifact trait. It is linked to the From the Shadows (priest artifact trait) and Mass Hysteria traits.
Mikey Schaefer is a human located at the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Miserain Starsorrow is a blood elf fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. She died after the portal was destroyed.

Miss Danna is a human school teacher who takes school children on a tour around Stormwind City. They visit the Cathedral of Light, the front gate to Stormwind Keep, and the Valley of Heroes. While walking between locations, they travel along the canals and through Cathedral Square and the Trade District.

Mistress Sassz'ine is a naga sea witch located in Tomb of Sargeras. She has come to the tomb to take the Tidestone of Golganneth for Queen Azshara and tainted the denizens of the ocean beneath the tomb.

Mithras Ironhill is a dwarf located in the map room of Stormwind Keep, in the human city of Stormwind. He can be found looking over a large map, alongside battlemasters Devin Fardale and Alison Devay.
Mithlos Falconbriar is a night elf druid trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City.

Molten Fury is a mage talent that increases damage done to targets with less than 35% health by 4% per rank, up to 12% at max rank 3. This talent provides a straight 12% DPS increase for the last one third of a mob's health, for an overall DPS increase of 4% on average. The talent is popular among Fire-specced PvE raiding mages. The last 35% of a raid boss fight can be the most critical, with low mana and dead players. By the 35% mark, aggro is firmly established and DPS classes are free to unload, making the effective DPS increase much more valuable. Also, because this is a multiplicative damage increase, it increases more effectively as other vulnerabilities are applied to the target (such

Molok was a wild dwarf gryphon rider under the command of Falstad Wildhammer, guarding the town of Hasic. He helped to defeat a dragon that was attacking Rhonin and Vereesa Windrunner although he lost an axe during the fight. He got into a quarrel with Rhonin when the latter insisted he fly him to Khaz Modan, but Vereesa convinced Falstad to take them. He rode with Rhonin, and during the travel the group ran into a patrol of dragon riders from the Dragonmaw clan. Rhonin forced Molok to alternate between helping their allies and trying to make it to the shoreline of Khaz Modan. Molok died when he and Rhonin were knocked off their mount by a dragon. Falstad and Molok were called brothers.

Mojka was an orc grunt originally located on the upper level of The Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar. By the end of the Pandaria campaign, she was promoted to overseer; she can be found watching over prisoners in the Valley of Strength during the Siege of Orgrimmar, where she can be killed.
Mokthar Grimblade is an orc located at the Deathforge in Shadowmoon Valley.
Mok'ra is an orc flight master located at Frostwolf Overlook in Talador.
Moonlit Amice is an amice that gives bonuses to stamina and spirit.

Monte Muzzleshot is a dwarf and member of the Nesingwary Safari located in the Wildgrowth Mangal of Sholazar Basin. At the time of the war against the Lich King, Monte Muzzleshot and his flying machine were sent to bring supplies to Hemet Nesingwary. However, he got shot down in the jungle by a pilot of the Venture Company, and hung for days from the branches of a tree, caught by his parachute. Fortunately, many of the trees are laden with fruit, so Monte shouldn't starve. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard met Monte and reported that he now runs a fruit trading business, being as he got so well acquainted with the local fruit while he was trying to get out of tha
Moonbell is a night elf stable master located outside of the Silver Covenant Pavilion in Icecrown. She's got a pet owl named Anmarie. She was present during Death Rising.
Monishot is a human fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. She died after the portal was destroyed.
Moonfall Stalker is a spider demon located in Suramar during Breaking the Seal.

Morgum is an orc leather armor vendor located in the Kodohide Leatherworkers shop in the Drag in Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, he was located in Soran's Leather and Steel Armory in the Valley of Strength. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Karolek.
Morgg Stormshot is a dwarf located at the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Morla Skyblade is an orc flight master located at Serpent's Spine Horde Tower in Kun-Lai Summit.

Morgus Grimhatchet is a dwarf death knight found at Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest. He is an adventurer, a highly dangerous one with only loose affiliations to the Alliance, but a high-priority target for the Horde nonetheless. He has a pet ghoul named Alebrain and appears to specialize in frost magic.
Moriccalas is a human death knight fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He died after the portal was destroyed.

Morris Lawry is a human beggar located in the Canal District of the human city of Stormwind. He is evidently very poor and offers various services to those who pass, as well as begging for change. Whether these items belong to Lawry or he is simply oblivious to them is unknown.
Mother Matterly is a human innkeeper located at Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands. She uses the building recently rebuilt after being destroyed by the Scourge many years ago.
Mother Igarashi is a night elf located at Nighthaven in Moonglade.
Motrek is a jungle troll witch doctor located in Orgrimmar. He wants to study the venom of couatl of Zandalar, and sends adventurers to capture the beasts and transport them to the city.
Motion Sick Peon is an orc located in Grimrail Depot, the Black Forge of Blackrock Foundry, and the Dragon Soul. He provides the Motion Sick Peon's Magical Elixir for free.
